scripts.slides: mkdir -p build && marp --theme-set theme --html -w -p -o build/preview.html slides.md
scripts.slides:watch: mkdir -p build && marp --theme-set theme --html -w -o build/preview.html slides.md
scripts.slides:pdf: mkdir -p build && marp --theme-set theme --pdf --allow-local-files -o build/agentic-runtime-summit.pdf slides.md
